scope: Physical M1 iPad. Four real layout preparations per second or one real disk-backed reader per second, 360 seconds per run. Calendar alternates widths and zoom. Mail cycles four workloads. Each build runs in a fresh isolated Release-optimized probe. Process CPU is cumulative user plus system time at a fixed work count. Battery telemetry samples the whole plugged-in device every 15 seconds. Use per-run differences and consider adapter limits, display, battery state and thermal state. Sampling endpoints and cached storage are not controlled tightly enough for a per-gesture joule figure.
